(d) Market risks
market risk is the risk that changes in market prices, such as interest rate, equity prices, foreign exchange rates and credit spreads
(not relating to changes in the obligor’s / issuer’s credit standing) will affect the Group’s and the Bank’s income or the value of
its holdings of financial instruments. the objective of market risk management is to manage and control market risk exposures
within acceptable parameters, while optimising the return on risk.
